jobs.title: Foundry Program Manager, Service Operations and Program Management
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
Role Summary:
The Foundry Program Manager will play a critical role in advancing Intel Foundry transformation initiatives by driving operational excellence, governance, business process execution, and data-driven decision-making for OSAT-like service offerings. This role is responsible for sustaining service management frameworks, enabling business insights through analytics, enhancing reporting discipline, and ensuring effective cross-functional collaboration among manufacturing, engineering, finance, automation, and business operations teams.

In addition to supporting strategic Foundry transformation objectives, this position requires a strong factory integrator capable of leading and executing new product introductions, process transfers, and technology validation in Assembly and Test Manufacturing sites and being as SPOC to connect upstream facilities within APTM for NPI programs . The successful candidate will serve as a key bridge between development and HVM, ensuring technologies, platforms, and products achieve certification readiness and operational excellence prior to production ramp in ATM.

This role combines strategic program leadership with hands-on manufacturing integration expertise, enabling successful execution of Foundry business models and operational transformation initiatives defined by the ATM Foundry Program Office.

Key Responsibilities:
Foundry Program Focus
• Lead day-to-day execution of Foundry service programs, ensuring effective governance, operational discipline, and performance management.
• Own service metrics, data quality, dashboards, and business-value reporting for operational and executive reviews.
• Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Finance, Automation, and Business Operations teams to ensure accurate service tracking, value realization, and business alignment.
• Support service monetization, cost modeling, and business process governance to enable scalable Foundry operations.
• Drive continuous improvements that enhance service visibility, customer responsiveness, and operational efficiency.
• Develop executive updates, scorecards, benchmarking analyses, and program reviews to support strategic decision-making.
• Maintain service playbooks, operating procedures, and training materials to ensure consistent execution and long-term program sustainability.

ATM Integration Focus:
• Lead New Product Introduction/Integration, factory startup, and process transfer activities across development and manufacturing organizations.
• Own NPI execution, roadmap, milestones, and readiness reviews from initial launch through HVM.
• Serve as the SPOC for assigned programs, driving stakeholder alignment, risk management, and issue resolution.
• Partner with Product Design, PDT, ATTD, Manufacturing, Automation, and Quality teams to ensure product, process, and manufacturing readiness.
• Lead technical reviews and data-driven problem solving to resolve product and process challenges.
• Ensure ES, QS, PRQ, PROD, certification, quality, performance, and customer requirements are achieved.
• Drive continuous improvement of NPI systems, processes, and operational excellence through post-launch learning and optimization.

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, or a related technical field.
• 5+ years of experience in semiconductor manufacturing, engineering, manufacturing operations, business operations, or program management.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, reporting, and stakeholder management skills.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional programs and drive execution in a complex manufacturing environment.
•
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in semiconductor manufacturing, Foundry, OSAT, NPI, or factory operations.
• Knowledge of product/process integration, manufacturing readiness, and technology transfer processes.
• Experience with KPI dashboards, business analytics, governance frameworks, and operational reporting.
• Understanding of service-based business models, operational benchmarking, and customer-facing manufacturing operations.
• Proficiency in Power BI, Excel, and business process documentation tools.

jobs.title: Logistics Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
The Role and Impact
As a Logistics Operations Manager, you will oversee logistics operations for inbound, interplant, and outbound materials, equipment, and finished goods, ensuring seamless execution of critical processes that drive Intel's Global Logistics Organization performance. Your role will directly impact operational excellence, ensuring timely deliveries, optimized solutions, and adherence to compliance standards. You will lead key logistics initiatives, resolve escalations, and contribute to continuous improvement efforts that enhance cost efficiency, speed, quality, and reliability.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage logistics operations for inbound, interplant, and outbound shipments of materials, equipment, and finished goods, ensuring continuity of deliveries.

- Provide dock operations ownership to support site start-up, ramp, and steady-state logistics execution.

- Monitor and drive performance against logistics KPIs, compliance requirements, and operational standards.

- Analyze logistics processes and data to identify inefficiencies, defects, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

- Track, escalate, and resolve shipping, warehouse, carrier, and execution exceptions.

- Lead critical logistics escalations to minimize disruptions and ensure customer satisfaction.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external logistics providers to optimize supply chain execution.

- Leverage analytical and digital tools to develop solutions that enhance cost, speed, quality, and reliability.

- Deliver regular updates to senior leaders on logistics performance, risk assessments, and operational readiness.

- Anticipate business and customer needs, ensuring operational readiness to support capacity growth, customer ramps, and strategic initiatives.

- Drive a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across internal teams and external logistics providers.

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, or a related field.

- Minimum 4 years of experience in logistics operations or 3PL management with a Bachelor's degree; or 3 years of experience with a Master's degree.

- Expertise in warehouse operations, compliance, and supplier governance, with a proven track record of owning execution end-to-end.

- Proficiency in SAP/WMS systems, inventory control, and performance metric tracking, with demonstrated ability to identify issues and implement corrective actions.

- Strong analytical skills, with experience in translating data into actionable decisions and sustained improvements.

- Technical proficiency in monitoring logistics KPIs and driving operational excellence.

Preferred Qualifications
- Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, and rapidly changing operational environment.

- Demonstrated track record of taking initiative, driving results independently, and leading through ambiguity.

- Strong sense of ownership and urgency, with the ability to balance strategic priorities and day-to-day operational execution.

- Experience supporting customer ramps, operational transformations, or large-scale logistics readiness initiatives.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Operations Manager (Contract)
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
- Manages and leads a team of technicians overseeing operations, equipment maintenance, and repair in manufacturing facilities.
- Owns safety, quality, scheduling, and conflict resolution amongst staff and other stakeholders and assists in resolving operational, safety, and security issues.
- Oversees flow of work through factories and streamlining processes and operations between groups and divisions.
- Establishes tactical plans to ensure production schedules are met within established quality and cost objectives.
- Ensures optimum total area performance in terms of safety, quality, output, and cost through staffing training development and retention of the group.
- Understands scheduled and unscheduled equipment maintenance, repair, recovery, troubleshooting, tool quality, and tool run rate.
- Assumes direct ownership and acts as the first responder of all on-shift issues within assigned toolset or area.
- Works with engineering teams to solve problems impacting factory operations/health.
- Ensures effective employee staffing including workstation assignment, shift rotations, and PTO requests.
- Owns shift schedule including workstation assignments/rotations, employee training, employee vacations, employee breaks, overtime assignment, back-up for absent employees, and shift rotations.
- Establishes training plans for direct reports and monitor training performance against schedule to assure shift team has skills needed to sustain production.
- Regularly reviews staffing certification levels that are tied to wafer ramp levels and ensures performance required number of certified individuals for each ramp threshold.
- Develops long-term strategies for manufacturing operations capabilities to support future requirements.
- Responsible for enabling teams to execute through clear goal setting, facilitating work, maintaining accountability, applying differentiated performance management, and driving team results.
- Drives results by inspiring people, role modeling Intel values, developing the capabilities of others, and ensuring a productive work environment.

Qualifications:
- Minimum 2 years and above of relevant professional experience, including at least 1 year of experience leading a team of technicians.
- Strong engineering or technical background is required.
- Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering-related field, such as Electrical & Electronics, Mechanical, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.
- Able to work effectively in a fast-paced, startup-style environment and manage stress well.
- Willing and able to work onsite in Kulim.
- Willingness to work on shifts as required.

jobs.title: Logistics Operations Manager (Transportation) (Contract)
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
The Role and Impact
As a Logistics Operations Manager Transportation, you will oversee and drive logistics operations across one or more categories, ensuring seamless execution of inbound, interplant, and outbound material flows. You will play a vital role in monitoring performance metrics, resolving escalations, and implementing continuous improvements to optimize logistics processes. Your contributions will strengthen Intel's operational capabilities, ensuring efficient and reliable delivery of products to customers globally.

Business group
The Logistics Operations Manager role falls within Intel's Supply Chain organization, which focuses on ensuring the efficient movement of materials, equipment, and finished goods to support the manufacturing process and customer delivery. This team drives operational excellence through innovation, process optimization, and supplier collaboration, contributing to Intel's mission of delivering world-class products to customers worldwide.

Key Responsibilities
- Own and manage logistics operations for inbound, interplant, and outbound materials, equipment, and finished goods.
- Provide dock operations ownership to support site start-up, ramp, and steady-state logistics execution.
- Monitor and drive performance against logistics KPIs, compliance requirements, and operational standards.
- Analyze logistics processes and data to identify inefficiencies, defects, and continuous improvement opportunities.
- Track, escalate, and resolve shipping, warehouse, carrier, and execution exceptions to ensure continuity of deliveries.
- Manage critical logistics escalations, minimizing impact to operations and customer service.
- Partner closely with cross-functional teams and external logistics providers to ensure seamless execution.
- Utilize analytical and digital tools to develop logistics solutions that optimize cost, speed, quality, and reliability.
- Provide regular updates to senior leaders on schedule, scope, cost, risk, and execution readiness.
- This position also plays a significant role in preparing for the ongoing Assembly Test and Wafer Sort factory operations startup.

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Logistics, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, or related discipline.
- 4+ years of experience in logistics operations or third-party logistics (3PL) management with a proven ability to operate independently in dynamic conditions.
- Proficiency in SAP/Transportation Management Systems (TMS), 4PL and 3PL freight supplier management, and performance metric tracking, with demonstrated capability to self-identify issues and drive corrective actions.
- Strong knowledge of transportation operations, compliance protocols, and supplier governance, with a track record of owning execution end-to-end.
- Advanced proficiency in data analysis to drive operational improvements and informed decision-making.
- Expertise in transportation management systems and logistics management software.
- Minimum basic knowledge in Malaysian Customs processes, procedures and operations, including clear understanding on the local and federal regulations and compliance.

Preferred Qualifications
- Demonstrated leadership in managing logistics escalations and driving operational improvements across global teams.
- Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and drive outcomes effectively.

We encourage you to bring your passion for logistics excellence and innovation to Intel. Apply today and be part of a team that delivers cutting-edge solutions while shaping the future of operations globally.
